display_long_description:
Try free and feel the tools. Build real furniture from blueprints—measure, cut, drill and screw each piece into place with clear on-piece guides.

Carpenter Simulator VR brings hands-on woodworking to virtual reality. Start with raw planks, follow simple plans, and assemble step by step. The controls are straightforward, the flow is smooth, and every action feels tactile and satisfying—perfect for short sessions or relaxed build nights.

• Follow blueprints from start to finish
• Use familiar tools: Hammers, screws
• Clear snap/placement guides for accurate builds
• Short, relaxing builds—easy to pick up, hard to put down

🛠️ Resolved an issue preventing stamina from recovering after level reload.
⚡ Optimized performance for a smoother gameplay experience.
Hey everyone!

This update is all about making the game smoother and easier to jump into. We’ve fixed a bunch of annoying bugs to improve overall performance, so things should feel better while you play.

We also added a quick intro/tutorial at the start to help you get the hang of everything faster—especially if you're new.

If you run into any issues or have ideas to make the game more fun, feel free to drop us your feedback. We’re always listening and working to improve the experience!

Thanks for playing ❤️
